title: Biased monomial
statement: Let $p\in(0,1)$, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,+1\}^n$. The biased monomial indexed by $S$ is the product-basis function associated with the multi-index that is $1$ on $S$ and $0$ elsewhere, evaluated at $x$.
